---
name: sdlc
description: Manage project-owned work items, requirements, independent reviews and lessons using the SDLC tools.
---

Read `.work-item/README.md`. Begin by reading `sdlc_metrics`; it never initializes
or launches anything. Create tasks only when requested. Include verifiable
requirements and dependencies. Obtain explicit user approval before work starts.
Use the planner, worker and judge definitions in `.github/agents/`. Use the same
`sdlc_*` tools in VS Code Chat and SDK sessions. Custom project tools are listed
through `sdlc_project_tool`. Keep state changes in tools, project knowledge in
project files and unresolved business decisions in the questions ledger.
